apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: app-config
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
    managed-by: "platform"
    tenant: "t1"
data:
  app.json: '{"feature":true}'

---
# Source: app/templates/workloads.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: api-cache
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
    managed-by: "platform"
    tenant: "t1"
    app.kubernetes.io/component: "api"
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  storageClassName: local-path
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: "1Gi"

---
# Source: app/templates/workloads.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: shop-web
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
    managed-by: "platform"
    tenant: "t1"
    app.kubernetes.io/component: "web"
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
    app.kubernetes.io/component: "web"
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: http
      name: http

---
# Source: app/templates/workloads.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: shop-api
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
    managed-by: "platform"
    tenant: "t1"
    app.kubernetes.io/component: "api"
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
    app.kubernetes.io/component: "api"
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: http
      name: http

---
# Source: app/templates/workloads.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
    managed-by: "platform"
    tenant: "t1"
    app.kubernetes.io/component: "web"
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
      app.kubernetes.io/component: "web"
  template:
    metadata:

      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/component: web
        app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
        managed-by: platform
        tenant: t1
    spec:

      serviceAccountName: shop-web
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "reg.onprem.example/platform/t1/shop-web@sha256:fcb75f691c8b0414d670ae57\
            0240cbf95502cc18a9ba57e982ecac589760a186"
          args:
            - -listen=:8080
            - -text=web ok
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
              name: http
          env:
            - name: API_URL
              value: http://shop-api:80
          resources:
            limits:
              memory: 256Mi
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: http
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            runAsNonRoot: true

---
# Source: app/templates/workloads.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
    managed-by: "platform"
    tenant: "t1"
    app.kubernetes.io/component: "api"
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
      app.kubernetes.io/component: "api"
  template:
    metadata:

      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/component: api
        app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
        managed-by: platform
        tenant: t1
    spec:

      serviceAccountName: shop-api
      initContainers:
        - command:
            - sh
            - -c
            - "true"
          image: busybox:1.36
          name: wait-db
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "reg.onprem.example/platform/t1/shop-api@sha256:fcb75f691c8b0414d670ae57\
            0240cbf95502cc18a9ba57e982ecac589760a186"
          command:
            - /http-echo
          args:
            - -listen=:3000
            - -text=api ok
          ports:
            - containerPort: 3000
              name: http
          env:
            - name: DB_HOST
              value: shop-db-rw
            - name: DB_PORT
              value: "5432"
            - name: DB_USER
              value: app
            - name: DB_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  key: password
                  name: shop-db-app
            - name: JWT_SECRET
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  key: JWT_SECRET
                  name: shop-secrets
          resources:
            limits:
              memory: 512Mi
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 256Mi
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /ready
              port: http
          volumeMounts:
            - mountPath: /etc/app
              name: cfg-app-config
              readOnly: true
            - mountPath: /etc/tls
              name: sec-tls
              readOnly: true
            - mountPath: /var/cache/app
              name: pvc-cache
        - command:
            - sh
            - -c
            - sleep infinity
          image: busybox:1.36
          name: log
      volumes:
        - configMap:
            name: app-config
          name: cfg-app-config
        - name: sec-tls
          secret:
            secretName: shop-tls
        - name: pvc-cache
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: api-cache

---
# Source: app/templates/workloads.yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: api
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
    managed-by: "platform"
    tenant: "t1"
    app.kubernetes.io/component: "api"
spec:
  scaleTargetRef: { apiVersion: apps/v1, kind: Deployment, name: api }
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 6
  metrics:
    - type: Resource
      resource: { name: cpu, target: { type: Utilization, averageUtilization: 70 } }

---
# Source: app/templates/workloads.yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: migrate
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
    managed-by: "platform"
    tenant: "t1"
    app.kubernetes.io/component: "migrate"
spec:
  template:
    metadata:

      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/component: migrate
        app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
        managed-by: platform
        tenant: t1
    spec:

      serviceAccountName: shop-api
      restartPolicy: OnFailure
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "busybox:1.36"
          command:
            - sh
            - -c
            - echo migrated

---
# Source: app/templates/workloads.yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: nightly
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
    managed-by: "platform"
    tenant: "t1"
    app.kubernetes.io/component: "nightly"
spec:
  schedule: "0 3 * * *"
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  suspend: true
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      backoffLimit: 2
      template:
        metadata:

          labels:
            app.kubernetes.io/component: nightly
            app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
            managed-by: platform
            tenant: t1
        spec:

          serviceAccountName: shop-api
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
          containers:
            - name: app
              image: "reg.onprem.example/platform/t1/shop-api@sha256:fcb75f691c8b0414d670ae57\
                0240cbf95502cc18a9ba57e982ecac589760a186"
              command:
                - /http-echo
              args:
                - -version

---
# Source: app/templates/ingress.yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: shop
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
    managed-by: "platform"
    tenant: "t1"
spec:
  rules:
    - host: "shop.example.com"
      http:
        paths:
          - path: "/"
            pathType: Prefix
            backend: { service: { name: shop-web, port: { number: 80 } } }

---
# Source: app/templates/cnpg.yaml
apiVersion: postgresql.cnpg.io/v1
kind: Cluster
metadata:
  name: shop-db
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
    managed-by: "platform"
    tenant: "t1"
spec:
  instances: 1
  imageName: "ghcr.io/cloudnative-pg/postgresql:16"
  storage: { size: "20Gi" }
  resources:
    limits:
      memory: 1Gi
    requests:
      cpu: 500m
      memory: 1Gi
  bootstrap:
    initdb: { database: "shop", owner: "app" }
  postgresql:
    parameters:
      wal_level: logical

---
# Source: app/templates/externalsecret.yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: shop-secrets
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
    managed-by: "platform"
    tenant: "t1"
spec:
  refreshInterval: 1h
  secretStoreRef:
    kind: ClusterSecretStore
    name: vault
  target:
    name: shop-secrets
  data:
    - secretKey: "JWT_SECRET"
      remoteRef:
        key: "shop/app"
        property: "JWT_SECRET"

---
# Source: app/templates/externalsecret.yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: shop-tls
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
    managed-by: "platform"
    tenant: "t1"
spec:
  refreshInterval: 1h
  secretStoreRef:
    kind: ClusterSecretStore
    name: vault
  target:
    name: shop-tls
    template: { type: "kubernetes.io/tls" }
  data:
    - secretKey: "tls.crt"
      remoteRef:
        key: "shop/tls"
        property: "tls.crt"
    - secretKey: "tls.key"
      remoteRef:
        key: "shop/tls"
        property: "tls.key"
